canonical_project: Wuhu National Data Center Cluster Start-up Area
owner: Anhui Provincial Government / Wuhu municipal authorities / multiple operators
notes: Anhui government measures define the Wuhu cluster start-up area as Jiujiang District, Yijiang District, and Wuwei City. Trade reporting says Huawei Cloud, China Telecom, China Mobile, China Unicom, Sugon, Volcano Engine, and other projects have landed in the area.
